title: $τ$-bench: A Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction in Real-World Domains
inclusion_rationale: Tau-bench provides policy-bound airline and retail dialogues, database end states, and repeated-run reliability.

title: ToolSandbox: A Stateful, Conversational, Interactive Evaluation Benchmark for LLM Tool Use Capabilities
inclusion_rationale: ToolSandbox evaluates stateful tools, implicit dependencies, user interaction, and trajectory milestones.

title: SOPBench: Evaluating Language Agents at Following Standard Operating Procedures and Constraints
inclusion_rationale: SOPBench uses executable policies and rule-based verifiers across seven customer-service domains.

title: $τ^2$-Bench: Evaluating Conversational Agents in a Dual-Control Environment
inclusion_rationale: Tau2-bench evaluates coordinated user and agent state changes in dynamic support environments.

title: Effective Red-Teaming of Policy-Adherent Agents
inclusion_rationale: Policy-aware adversarial users expose compliance failures in task-oriented agents.

title: AgentChangeBench: A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation Framework for Goal-Shift Robustness in Conversational AI
inclusion_rationale: Multi-turn enterprise benchmark directly measures goal-shift recovery, redundancy, efficiency, and task success.

title: Automated test generation to evaluate tool-augmented LLMs as conversational AI agents
inclusion_rationale: The study contributes a procedure-grounded customer-support benchmark for complete tool-using conversations.

title: Beyond IVR: Benchmarking Customer Support LLM Agents for Business-Adherence
inclusion_rationale: JourneyBench directly evaluates policy-bound customer-support workflows and structured dynamic orchestration.

title: Catching One in Five: LLM-as-Judge Blind Spots in Production Multi-Turn Transaction Agents
inclusion_rationale: Production transaction traces show that common judging misses cross-turn state, guardrail, and recovery defects.

title: Cordon: Semantic Transactions for Tool-Using LLM Agents
inclusion_rationale: Semantic transactions stage and validate composed tool effects before commit and provide task-level rollback and audit.

title: CRMArena: Understanding the Capacity of LLM Agents to Perform Professional CRM Tasks in Realistic Environments
inclusion_rationale: CRMArena provides expert-designed customer-service CRM tasks with executable tools and end-state evaluation.

title: Enforcing Temporal Constraints for LLM Agents
inclusion_rationale: Temporal policies are formally specified and enforced over action sequences at agent runtime.

title: Flexible Agent Alignment with Goal Inference from Open-Ended Dialog
inclusion_rationale: The method dynamically extracts and updates natural-language goals from open-ended multi-turn dialogue.

title: Hell or High Water: Evaluating Agentic Recovery from External Failures
inclusion_rationale: The benchmark injects recoverable external tool failures and measures alternative-plan recovery under controlled solvability.

title: PolicyBank: Evolving Policy Understanding for LLM Agents
inclusion_rationale: Structured policy insights are updated and retrieved per turn in long-horizon transactional conversations.

title: Push Your Agent: Measuring and Enforcing Quantitative Goal Persistence in Long-Horizon LLM Agents
inclusion_rationale: The benchmark and controllers externalize verified quantitative goal progress and measure persistence and drift.

title: ReliabilityBench: Evaluating LLM Agent Reliability Under Production-Like Stress Conditions
inclusion_rationale: Repeated execution, perturbation, and fault injection directly operationalize agent stability and recovery.

title: SABER: Small Actions, Big Errors -- Safeguarding Mutating Steps in LLM Agents
inclusion_rationale: Trace analysis isolates mutating actions as decisive failures and evaluates verification immediately before those actions.

title: Solver-Aided Verification of Policy Compliance in Tool-Augmented LLM Agents
inclusion_rationale: Natural-language policies are compiled into solver constraints and checked before tool invocation.

title: $τ$-Knowledge: Evaluating Conversational Agents over Unstructured Knowledge
inclusion_rationale: The benchmark combines unstructured evidence retrieval, policy reasoning, tools, and verifiable banking state changes.

title: The Verifier Tax: Horizon Dependent Safety Success Tradeoffs in Tool Using LLM Agents
inclusion_rationale: The study quantifies safety-success and recovery tradeoffs from runtime policy mediation in transactional airline and retail tasks.

title: Towards Enforcing Company Policy Adherence in Agentic Workflows
inclusion_rationale: Company policies are compiled into transparent guards that check each proposed tool action before execution.

title: When Agents Overtrust Environmental Evidence: An Extensible Agentic Framework for Benchmarking Evidence-Grounding Defects in LLM Agents
inclusion_rationale: The benchmark directly measures provenance, freshness, authority, and action-grounding defects in environment evidence.

title: When Retrieval Metrics Mislead: Measuring Policy Signal in Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
inclusion_rationale: The study tests policy retrieval and structured decision state for pre-action compliance classification.

title: fastWorkflow: Closing the Performance Gap Between Small and Frontier Language Models for Conversational Agents
inclusion_rationale: The study develops a modular conversational workflow architecture and evaluates component ablations, three independent trials, stability, and cost on tau-bench Retail and Airline.
